_doc: The ONE place the ONNX Runtime version is pinned (issue #85). libarc's CMake build downloads the archive for the target platform, checks its sha256 and the library's sha256, and copies the library + its licence next to libarc (<build>/onnxruntime/), with onnxruntime.json; the model server loads that copy (model_server/app/nft2.py) and checks its sha256 again at load. model_server/pyproject.toml pins the Python wheel (the embedder, Steer TTS) to the same version; model_server/tests/test_bindings.py fails when the two differ. To move to another version: update version + every platform entry (archive sha256 from the GitHub release's asset digest, lib_sha256 of the extracted library), pyproject.toml's onnxruntime==, uv lock, rebuild, run the ear tests.
